GAIN 2026 Pilot Desk
EGRISS · GAIN 2026 survey · pilot

Six colleagues left you their notes. Fill in the survey as one of them.

Each folder below is a real organisation and an invented colleague who has handed the GAIN survey over to you. Their notes are not in survey order, so you will have to dig. We are testing the survey, not you: every moment you hesitate tells us something about the form.

01Choose any folder you like. Each one is a different organisation and colleague. Read the paperwork once, start to finish, before you open the survey.
02Fill in the survey with your own name. For the email, use your work address or a made-up one such as yourname@example.org. For your position, use your persona's job.
03Use the clock next to the notes to track your time: start it when you open the survey and stop it when you submit. We compare times in the feedback round.
04Each time you pause, re-read or go back, jot it down on paper. Bring your notes and your time to the feedback round.
